WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_count
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
top_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id
  FROM customer_order_counts
  ORDER BY orders_count DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_purchase_timestamp,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_payment_total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
  GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(COALESCE(order_payment_total, 0.0)) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(order_payment_total) AS average_order_value,
    MIN(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_purchase_date,
    MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_purchase_date
  FROM order_totals
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
review_agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    AVG(CAST(orv.review_score AS DOUBLE)) AS average_review_score
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_reviews orv ON o.order_id = orv.order_id
  WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  ca.customer_unique_id,
  ca.total_orders,
  ca.total_revenue,
  ca.average_order_value,
  ra.average_review_score,
  ca.first_purchase_date,
  ca.last_purchase_date
FROM customer_aggregates ca
LEFT JOIN review_agg ra USING (customer_unique_id)
ORDER BY ca.total_orders DESC;
